title: 2024 Bowman Chrome Jaron Elkins 1st Bowman #BCP-106 Los Angeles LA Dodgers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Bowman Chrome trading card featuring rookie player Jaron Elkins from the Los Angeles Dodgers. This baseball card is part of the Major League (MLB) set and has the card number BCP-106. Manufactured by Bowman, this Chrome parallel/variety card is a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection, especially for fans of the Los Angeles Dodgers or collectors of rookie cards.
